name: api_flux3_image_edit_1img
description: FLUX 3 Image (Black Forest Labs' closed flagship image model) image edit with one reference image, via the Flux3ImageNode partner node on Comfy Cloud (requires a configured API key; billed per image by resolution tier). Mirrors ComfyUI's official api_bfl_flux3_image_edit template. The prompt is interpreted and expanded server-side, with optional web/image-search grounding. aspect_ratio picks one of 15 ratios from 21:9 to 9:21; omit it and the output follows image 1. The node's seed only forces a re-run (FLUX 3 picks its own), so it is not exposed. Up to 10 references are supported upstream; this template wires 1.

prompt.description: Edit or composition instruction. Refer to the reference as image 1 (plain words, not tags).

image1.description: Reference image (image 1). With aspect_ratio omitted the output follows its shape. At least 256x256 pixels.

resolution.description: Output size at the chosen aspect ratio, billed per image by tier: '0.75K' ~0.6 MP (~$0.059), '1K' ~1 MP (~$0.069, default, as in the official template), '1.5K' ~2.4 MP (~$0.10), '2K' ~4.2 MP (~$0.14), '4K' ~16.8 MP (~$0.87).

grounding.description: 'on' (default) lets FLUX 3 research the prompt with web and image search before generating, which helps with real products, places and people in the news. 'off' skips it.
